item.title: Haskell Effect Systems in 2026: effectful vs polysemy vs fused-effects vs mtl
item.description: Your App monad has grown to nine stacked transformers, the type signatures no longer fit on one line, and every new capability forces you to edit a MonadFoo instance chain that nobody on the team fully understands. That is the exact pain every Haskell team hits somewhere between 5k and 50k lines — and it is why effect systems exist.
